entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Individual decision-makers: leaders, commanders, mediators driving the conflict outcome

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Position held (e.g., US President, Israeli PM, Supreme Leader)

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: high/medium/low causal influence on the forecast outcome

entity_types.selection_rule: Named individuals whose personal decisions causally gate escalation, strikes, sanctions relief or negotiation

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Institutions and armed groups: militaries, verification bodies, proxies, coalitions
entity_types.selection_rule: Organized actors with coercive, operational, verification or mediation capacity affecting the conflict path
anti_examples: Think tanks cited as sources (CRS, ISIS, FRS)

entity_types.name: Government
entity_types.description: National governments and state groupings with sovereign policy levers

attributes.name: policy_lever
attributes.description: Main lever: mediation, oil purchases, arms transfers, regional exposure

entity_types.selection_rule: Sovereign states or groupings whose purchases, transfers or mediation causally shape the conflict and market outcome

entity_types.name: CentralBank
entity_types.description: Monetary authorities setting policy rates and accumulating gold reserves

attributes.name: mandate_jurisdiction
attributes.description: US, euro area, or global (gold buyers)

attributes.name: gold_buyer_flag
attributes.description: Whether a structural official gold accumulator

entity_types.selection_rule: Monetary institutions whose rate paths and reserve behavior price the macro and gold implications

entity_types.name: ProducerCartel
entity_types.description: Oil producer groups holding spare capacity and supply response options

attributes.name: output_level_mbd
attributes.description: Recent output and capacity in million b/d

entity_types.selection_rule: Producer coalitions whose output decisions buffer or amplify the Iranian supply shock

entity_types.name: NuclearProgram
entity_types.description: Iran's nuclear infrastructure and stockpile as a tracked object of strikes and verification

attributes.name: heu_stock_kg
attributes.description: Estimated surviving 60% enriched uranium in kg

entity_types.selection_rule: Named Iranian nuclear facilities or stockpiles whose reconstruction or verification status triggers scenarios
anti_examples: Breakout time as a general topic

entity_types.name: CommodityMarket
entity_types.description: Traded oil, gas, gold and shipping markets whose end-2027 prices are forecast

attributes.name: instrument
attributes.description: Brent, TTF, gold, tanker rates, CDS

attributes.name: current_level
attributes.description: Latest baseline reading and as-of date

entity_types.selection_rule: Specific priced instruments or chokepoint flow metrics that are the forecast deliverables

entity_types.name: ConflictScenario
entity_types.description: Mutually exclusive end-2027 conflict states with probabilities and priced implications

attributes.name: brent_path
attributes.description: Implied Brent path under this state

attributes.name: gold_path
attributes.description: Implied gold range under this state

entity_types.selection_rule: The five defined end-2027 outcome states used for scenario-weighted forecasts

edge_types.name: OPPOSES
edge_types.description: Adversarial stance or armed confrontation between actors
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source actively opposes or fights target

edge_types.name: SANCTIONS
edge_types.description: Imposition of economic sanctions or blockade by one actor on another

attributes.name: mechanism
attributes.description: naval blockade / OFAC designations / sectoral sanctions

edge_types.name: COMPETES_WITH
edge_types.description: Rivalry between organizations or factions for power or strategic advantage
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source and target are symmetric rivals

edge_types.name: DEPENDS_ON
edge_types.description: Asymmetric reliance of one actor on another's support or decisions
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source relies on target's backing or approval

edge_types.name: SUPPORTS
edge_types.description: Material or political backing, e.g., patron to proxy resupply

edge_types.name: BACKS
edge_types.description: Endorsement or enablement of a leader, faction or movement
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source backs or endorses target's position

edge_types.name: CUSTOMER_OF
edge_types.description: Purchase relationship, e.g., Chinese buying of Iranian crude

attributes.name: volume_mbd
attributes.description: Recent purchase volume in million b/d

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source is a buyer of target's goods

edge_types.name: PARTNERS_WITH
edge_types.description: Cooperative or mediation-channel relationship between actors
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source cooperates with target on negotiation or mediation

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: One actor's decisions shape another's choices or market outcomes
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source exerts influence over target's decisions

edge_types.name: SUPPLIES
edge_types.description: Supply of oil or goods to a consumer, e.g., OPEC+ to the US market

attributes.name: substitutability
attributes.description: Ease of substitution for displaced barrels

analysis_summary: 该预测问题以2026年10月的伊朗'消耗战'基线为起点，围绕五个互斥的2027年底冲突状态（低烈度冲突45%、大规模再打击25%、持久停火15%、谈判框架10%、政权危机5%）及其对布伦特、黄金、天然气、宏观政策与区域市场的定价影响展开。本体保留种子类型Person、Organization、Government（覆盖特朗普、内塔尼亚胡、穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊三位决策者，IRGC、IDF、CENTCOM、IAEA、真主党、胡塞等组织，以及中俄和海合会政府），新增CentralBank（美联储、欧央行、购金央行）、ProducerCartel（OPEC+）、NuclearProgram（福尔多、纳坦兹、伊斯法罕、Pickaxe Mountain等被追踪核设施）、CommodityMarket（布伦特、TTF、黄金、霍尔木兹流量等定价客体）与ConflictScenario（五种情景）五个领域类型，共8个实体类型。关系保留全部种子边类型，并新增TRIGGERS与CONSTRAINS两条因果边，将核设施重建/核查、OPEC+剩余产能、库存缓冲、中期选举政治等传导机制与情景及价格结果连接，支撑多智能体推演中的有代价、有时滞行动与情景加权定价。
